# Set log verbosity for heteroTests

<small>Source: [`R/utils.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/utils.R) · Help: `?ht_set_log_level`</small>

Controls which log messages emitted via [`ht_log()`](ht_log.md) are printed. Messages are
always captured when log capture is enabled, even if suppressed by the
threshold.

## Usage

```r
ht_set_log_level(level = c("INFO", "WARN", "ERROR", "SILENT"))
```

## Arguments

`level`
:   Character string specifying the minimum level to emit. Accepted
    values are "INFO", "WARN", "ERROR" and "SILENT".

## Value

The previous log level (invisibly).
